title: README is a required shipped input but not part of acceptance_input_hash
contract: ADR 0033 source/artifact input identity; ADR 0001 VAL-02 deliberately excludes prose from the runtime acceptance hash.
minimal_counterexample: Commit a README-only change in a disposable repository, compute before/after plans, and compare required-sdist README blob, tree_hash, acceptance_input_hash and preparation.sdist_contract.
observed: README blob and tree_hash change, and the sdist gate is selected, while acceptance_input_hash is unchanged.
expected: Document explicitly that acceptance_input_hash does not bind every shipped sdist input, or publish a separate sdist_input_hash derived from the complete source inventory alongside the runtime acceptance hash.
root_cause: New sdist_inputs select the gate, but are not added to the acceptance_input_hash predicate; README remains classified as pure prose under accepted ADR 0001.
acceptance_conditions: Make the distinct meanings of runtime acceptance input hash and complete sdist source inventory hash explicit in active evidence documentation.
If a dedicated sdist input hash is added, test that README-only changes alter it without expanding hosted pytest selection.
Preserve ADR 0001 prose policy and exact commit/tree receipt checks; do not silently redefine accepted ADR text.
limitations: No stale acceptance bypass was demonstrated: verify_local_receipt separately checks exact commit and tree at scripts/ci_execute.py:285-310, while the checked sdist receipt independently source-hashes README. This advisory does not invalidate current receipt binding.
exit_meaning: The counterexample assertions reproduced the distinction, not a product acceptance pass.
